## UML Testing Profile (UTP) Test Suite for Doorstop

**Requirement:** REQ011 - Doorstop shall store requirements in a permanent and secure manner.

**Test Cases:**

| ID | Title | Req ID | Kind | Preconditions | Inputs | Steps | Expected |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| TC-001 | Store requirement successfully | REQ011 | Positive | - Doorstop is running | Requirement data | 1. Create requirement with valid data. 2. Verify requirement is stored in database. | Requirement is stored with status "Created". |
| TC-002 | Store requirement with missing data | REQ011 | Negative | - Doorstop is running | Requirement data missing required fields | 1. Attempt to create requirement with missing data. 2. Verify error message is displayed. | Error message indicating missing required fields. |

**Requirement:** REQ012 - Doorstop shall handle change management of the requirements.

**Test Cases:**

| ID | Title | Req ID | Kind | Preconditions | Inputs | Steps | Expected |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| TC-003 | Change requirement successfully | REQ012 | Positive | - Requirement exists in database | Change request data | 1. Submit change request for existing requirement. 2. Verify change request is logged. | Change request is logged with status "Submitted". |
| TC-004 | Change requirement with invalid data | REQ012 | Negative | - Requirement exists in database | Change request data with invalid fields | 1. Submit change request with invalid data. 2. Verify error message is displayed. | Error message indicating invalid fields. |

**Requirement:** REQ013 - Doorstop shall associate requirements changes to existing developer identification.

**Test Cases:**

| ID | Title | Req ID | Kind | Preconditions | Inputs | Steps | Expected |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| TC-005 | Associate change request with developer | REQ013 | Positive | - Change request exists in database | Developer ID | 1. Assign developer to change request. 2. Verify developer is associated. | Developer is associated with change request. |

**Requirement:** REQ014 - Doorstop shall be scalable to support thousands of requirements.

**Test Cases:**

| ID | Title | Req ID | Kind | Preconditions | Inputs | Steps | Expected |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| TC-006 | Add 1000 requirements | REQ014 | Boundary | - Doorstop is running | 1000 requirement data | 1. Create 1000 requirements. 2. Verify all requirements are stored. | All 1000 requirements are stored. |
| TC-007 | Add 5000 requirements | REQ014 | Boundary | - Doorstop is running | 5000 requirement data | 1. Create 5000 requirements. 2. Verify all requirements are stored. | All 5000 requirements are stored. |

**Requirement:** REQ015 - Doorstop shall provide a lightweight installation method.

**Test Cases:**

| ID | Title | Req ID | Kind | Preconditions | Inputs | Steps | Expected |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| TC-008 | Install Doorstop with minimal dependencies | REQ015 | Positive | - System has required dependencies | Minimal installation options | 1. Run installation with minimal dependencies. 2. Verify installation completes successfully. | Installation completes successfully with minimal dependencies. |
